approachQuestion.prompt:
Packed Shelves. Decide whether a binary tree fills every level except possibly the last, and fills its last level from left to right with no gaps. Return a Boolean; an empty tree qualifies. The left and right child positions are distinct even when one is absent.

In examples, x(left,right) denotes a node labelled x, and - denotes an absent child. Example 1: Input: 1(2(4(-,-),5(-,-)),3(6(-,-),-)). Output: true. Example 2: Input: 1(2(-,5(-,-)),3(-,-)). Output: false. Example 3: Input: -. Output: true.

Constraints: 0 <= n <= 200000; labels are arbitrary signed 32-bit integers and may repeat. The immutable tree has child pointers only, no cycles or shared nodes. Shape is unrestricted. Decide only the placement of nodes, not the order of their values.

options.text: Process existing nodes in a FIFO queue. Inspect each left slot then right slot; once a missing slot is seen, reject any later non-missing slot. Enqueue only non-missing children.
options.feedback: FIFO order and left-before-right inspection enumerate child slots in layout order. A node after the first gap violates the definition.

options.text: Record all child slots in breadth-first order in an extra list, including missing ones; scan that list afterward to reject an existing child after any missing slot.
options.feedback: It checks exactly the right order for every tree, but the retained slot list is unnecessary. A single gap flag can be updated during traversal.

options.text: Return true whenever the heights of the root’s left and right subtrees differ by at most one.
options.feedback: Example 2 has root child heights 2 and 1, but still has an interior gap before node 5.

options.text: Return true if no node has a right child without a left child.
options.feedback: For 1(2(-,-),3(6(-,-),-)), the local rule holds everywhere, yet node 6 appears after missing slots under node 2.

feedback.reason: Completeness is a no-gap property of child positions, not merely a balance or node-count property.
details: Return true for an empty root. Otherwise enqueue the root and keep a false gap flag. Dequeue a node, inspect its left pointer then right pointer. A null sets gap; a non-null after gap returns false; an earlier non-null is enqueued. Return true after the queue empties. Keep no slot history.

After the first missing breadth-first child slot, every later child slot must also be empty. Inspect left before right. Checking only level sizes misses a hole followed by a later node on the same level.

complexityQuestion.prompt: For the revealed FIFO gap method, consider n >= 1 nodes. Let w be the maximum number of nodes on one level and h the height in nodes. What is the tight worst-case pair? Count the queue and gap flag; exclude the input and Boolean result. Queue operations take constant time and dequeued entries are released.
constraints: All legal shapes are allowed; do not assume balance. Heights count nodes, not edges.

Pointer access, comparisons, arithmetic on the stated integer ranges, and allocation/release of a fixed-size frame take constant time. No hashing is used. Count all live explicit frames; the method does not use language recursion or copy paths/subtrees unless explicitly stated.

options.text: O(n log n) time, O(w) auxiliary space

feedback.reason: Inspect each reached node once while retaining a width-sized queue.
details: Each reached node is enqueued and inspected at most once; a complete tree reaches all nodes. The queue spans at most two neighboring levels, using O(w) entries, and complete trees attain a wide queue.

In level order the definition is equivalent to all occupied positions preceding all empty positions. Inspecting slots left then right preserves this order; the flag detects exactly its first violation.
“O(n) time, O(h) auxiliary space”: This is a level-order queue, not an ancestor stack; complete wide trees have much greater width than height.

“O(n) time, O(w) auxiliary space”: Each reached node is enqueued and inspected at most once; a complete tree reaches all nodes. The queue spans at most two neighboring levels, using O(w) entries, and complete trees attain a wide queue.
“O(n) time, O(1) auxiliary space”: The gap flag is constant-size but the pending node queue is not.
“O(n log n) time, O(w) auxiliary space”: Slots are already visited in the required order. There is no sorting or repeated search.
